newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: LG Metals sees higher '97 metals output.
newsitem.headline: LG Metals sees higher '97 metals output.

text.p: LG Metals Corp, a unit of South Korea's LG Group, said on Monday its copper production was expected to rise 6.3 percent to 260,000 tonnes in 1997 from 244,500 tonnes in 1996.
LG Metals is South Korea's largest copper smelter and refiner and also produces gold and silver as by-products.
"Our production of the metals is expected to rise this year due to an improvement of productivity," LG Metals executive director Jung Joo-young told Reuters.
Jung said the company expected its gold output, including production using imported bullion, to rise 16.1 percent to 80 tonnes in 1997 from 68.9 tonnes in 1996.
Jung also said silver output, including that using imported bullion, was expected to rise 9.7 percent to 240 tonnes in 1997 from 218.7 tonnes a year ago.
